sentence.en: The Pace: 6.6% of papers in leading journals named AI methods in the 13 weeks to 16 Aug. That is up from 1.1% in 2015 to 2019, and up from 4.8% a year earlier. Clearly above the pre-AI level in 5 of 7 fields. Too few cases to judge in 1.
sentence.zh: 進度：截至 8 月 16 日的 13 週內，主要期刊有 6.6% 的論文提到 AI 方法，高於 2015 至 2019 年的 1.1%，也高於一年前的 4.8%。7 個領域中有 5 個明顯高於 AI 出現之前。有 1 個領域的案例太少，無法判斷。

text.en: Mathematicians proved that one kind of tile can fill a surface only without repeating.
A robot lab found a cheap metal mixture that splits water.
A journal says reviewers shared unpublished papers with an AI chatbot.

status_note.en: English-only edition. The Chinese text was not ready this morning, so this edition stays in English. Its findings will be translated later.
status_note.zh: 僅英文版。今天早上中文內容尚未完成，因此本期簡報維持英文。其中的發現之後會補上中文。
